# Recipe: Create Gmail Filter

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a gws recipe: create a Gmail filter that automatically labels, stars, archives, or otherwise categorizes incoming messages matching criteria (sender, subject, keywords). Walks through listing existing labels, creating a label, creating the filter (criteria + actions), and verifying it. Requires the gws-gmail utility skill plus the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: filters change how your inbox behaves — a bad criterion can archive mail you wanted to see, so verify before and after; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
